title: Repurpose a YouTube video into community and sales assets
purpose: Verify that repurposing preserves buyer pain and creates platform-native assets with conversion tracking.
prompt: Repurpose a YouTube video about 'AI automations Polish SMBs will actually pay for' into Skool, newsletter, LinkedIn, X, Shorts, and sales assets.
expected_behaviors: Extracts atomic ideas from the source promise.
Includes CTAs into Skool, email, or paid offer.
Adds a review checklist before scheduling.
failure_patterns: Copies the same text across platforms.
Creates no Skool or email asset.
judge_notes: Passing output must include a 7-day schedule and Skool discussion prompt.
